h: Pat Utomi urges better living standards after minister's remark that some Nigerians spend 120% of income on food
p: Political economist Pat Utomi has criticised the government after Finance Minister Taiwo Oyedele reportedly cited a survey in which some Nigerians spend more than their whole income on food. Utomi called for steps to improve living standards.
more: Households spending over 100% of income usually cover the gap through borrowing or savings.
Earlier surveys have also found food taking up most Nigerian household budgets.
